summary:
Implementation plan for adding the balanced Quran.com, Sunnah.com, and Alim.org scholarly modules:
1. Quran.com Word-by-Word Translation & Root Grammar Explorer with morphology, root breakdown, and lexical occurrences.
2. Sunnah.com Visual Sanad Narrator Chain drilldown with interactive transmission links, narrator credentials, and grading.
3. Alim.org Comparative 4-Madhab Fiqh matrix (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali) and Asbab al-Nuzul revelation contexts.
